inputs.content: Finite-dimensional linear algebra, Riesz representation and Hilbert adjoints; finite-dimensional norm equivalence; number-field integral lattices, local integrality, different/codifferent definitions and Chinese remaindering; additive approximation in finite adeles; basic topological groups and Haar integration; Tonelli, Bochner integration and absolutely convergent series. Exact finite characters, the rational Levi, column stabilizers, support/return dictionaries and all changes of quotient domain are proved in the manuscript.
